summary: Boot-time CPU feature probe: executes the CPUID instruction with leaf EAX=1 and tests EDX bit 23 (mask 0x800000). Returns 1 when the feature bit is set and 0 otherwise. When the feature is present, clears the MMX state via _m_empty() before returning 1. Identified as the MMX support check by the existing analysis fill; the bit-23-as-MMX label itself is DERIVED.

operations.description: Select CPUID input leaf: set EAX to 1 (feature information leaf).
Execute the CPUID instruction with EAX=1, reading the feature flags into EDX (and the other output registers).
Test the feature bit: when (EDX & 0x800000) == 0 (mask rendered by the decompiler as the unk_800000 constant at 0x00800000), take the early failure path.
Return 0 when the tested feature bit is clear.
Clear the MMX state via _m_empty() (empty MMX/FP multimedia state) before the success return.
Return 1 when the feature bit is set.
